entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Gulbene—Alūksne railway line is a narrow-gauge 750 mm railway that connects the cities of Gulbene and Alūksne. This is the only narrow-gauge railway line in the Baltic States with regular passenger services. Nowadays, the line is operated by SIA "Gulbenes-Alūksnes bānītis". Until 2010, the line ran 3 pairs of trains per day, but from February 2010, the morning trip was cancelled. On previously announced dates, the train travels with the steam locomotive "Ferdinands". Since 2000, a Bānītis festival has been organized on the Gulbene–Alūksne line on the first weekend of September to promote the train.
